// comment 4: targets: wildcard suffixes to monitor, e.g. vercel.app watches *.vercel.app

// comment 6: notify: telegram | discord | slack | ntfy | webhook | none

// comment 9: seconds without ANY feed data before rotating to the next feed
// comment 9b: v2.2.3: auto-switch to crt.sh polling after N minutes with no certstream data (0 = disabled)
// comment 10: telegram api base (change only for testing/proxying)
// comment 10b: optional discord webhook url (only used when notify = discord; DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL in .env wins)
// comment 10c: optional generic JSON webhook url (only used when notify = webhook; GENERIC_WEBHOOK_URL in .env wins)
// comment 10d: optional slack incoming webhook url (only used when notify = slack; SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL in .env wins)
// comment 10e: optional ntfy channel (only used when notify = ntfy; NTFY_TOPIC / NTFY_SERVER in .env win)
// comment 11: include wildcard SAN entries (*.foo.target.tld) in matching
// comment 12: regex list - matching domains that hit any of these are ignored
// comment 13: alerts are grouped per target and flushed at least every N seconds
// comment 14: max domains shown per grouped alert (rest is summarized as '+N more')
// comment 15: persistent seen-history so restarts never re-alert old subdomains
// comment 16: DNS enrichment (Sublert-style): resolve new subdomains to IPs, cached in dns-cache.json
// comment 17: match history (matches.jsonl) - powers the dashboard feed, -Export and -Summary
// comment 18: dark-mode dashboard: files in ~/.config/ctmon, live server via -Serve / -ServeBg
// comment 19: crt.sh settings (only used when the polling path runs)
// comment 20: hours between 'still alive' heartbeat messages (0 = disabled, telegram channel only)
